summary: Remote WebSocket-driven PTY shell exposes the host to full interactive RCE
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent connects out to a configurable WebSocket server (SERVER_URL / config.serverUrl) and treats server-sent messages as commands against a real PTY. In connection/index.js the socket 'message' handler dispatches terminal_create / terminal_input / terminal_resize / terminal_close events into a PTY spawning bash, powershell, or cmd, writing incoming bytes directly via term.pty.write(msg.data). Any party controlling the paired server has interactive shell control on the host running the agent. The same channel also handles an upgrade_agent message that runs npm install <pkgName>@latest from registry.npmjs.org and restarts the process under systemd/launchd/PM2, so a remote operator can force reinstall-and-restart in addition to executing shell commands. The service/linux.js installer modifies PATH to prepend ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin as part of its install shim.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
